target_customer: Software engineering teams that keep product and API documentation next to their code in GitHub
problem: Documentation goes stale because code ships without doc updates. FifthTry blocked deploys until the related documentation was updated and approved.
business_model: B2B SaaS documentation tool, pricing not found

founders.name: Deepak Angrula
founders.role: Co-founder (listed as former founder on YC page)
previous_startups: Startups in education, video on demand and insurance (outcomes not stated on YC page)

founders.name: Amit Upadhyay
founders.background_notes: Named as founder and CEO of FifthTry and fastn by the TheOrg and CB Insights directory listings, which the search returned; the YC page does not list him. Not verified on a company page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A GitHub integrated documentation editor with a deploy gate is standard web engineering with some hard parts around syncing docs to code review, built by a team of four.

defensibility.rationale: Docs hosted by the product create some lock in, but incumbents such as Notion and GitBook could add a GitHub check, and no data or network effect was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing an incumbent copied the deploy gating feature.

market_need_then: The YC description frames documentation rot as the pain; no dated spend, survey or customer evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand page evidence was found; trademark records show FifthTry, Inc. registered the separate FASTN mark.

outcome_analysis: The YC page marks FifthTry inactive, and the company site no longer resolves. No post-mortem or news about the end of the product was found, so the cause is not public. A directory lists a CEO who also runs fastn, and fastn is a trademark of FifthTry, Inc., which suggests the team moved effort to a different product, but no source states this.
notes: Company site www.fifthtry.com did not resolve in this session (likely dead). Both rounds rest on a single database (CB Insights), which is internally inconsistent about investors; the 2021 amount of about 1.17M is unverified. Round dates and amounts have no press cross-check. No dated competitor source found, so the list is empty. Whether the product was wound down or folded into fastn is not stated by any source opened.
